name: Envoy
description: Interclan relations are often entrusted to Envoys empowered to arrive at agreements and commit clan resources. Many Envoys are also spies.

negotiator.name: Negotiator
negotiator.description: You are the voice of your clan in diplomatic or contract negotiations.

spy.name: Spy
spy.description: You watch rival clans and analyse their activities.

duellist.name: Duellist
duellist.description: You fight as a champion of your clan in ritual honour duels.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: A blunder in a negotiation shames you and your clan. You are now Outcast — drop your SOC to 2 and you must take the Outcast or Outlaw career next term.
mishaps.3: You fail in a difficult assignment because of the manipulations of another Envoy. Gain them as a Rival.
mishaps.4: An assassin attempts to murder you. Roll Melee (Natural) or Recon 8+ to avoid the attempt. If you fail, you are injured; roll on the Injury table. If you succeed, you may continue in this career.
mishaps.5: You are dispatched to a distant world for a long period; by the time you return, your position has been taken by someone younger and more ambitious. Gain one of Survival 1, Pilot 1, Carouse 1 or Independence 1.
mishaps.6: A human ambassador insults you. Roll Tolerance 8+ to avoid eating them. If you succeed, you may continue in this career. If you fail, gain one of the human's allies as an Enemy.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your clan places you in a difficult situation. You can flee if you wish, salvaging something of your reputation but losing SOC −1. If you stay and fight, roll one of Diplomat, Investigate or Stealth 8+. If you succeed, gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll. If you fail, lose SOC −1 and suffer DM-2 to your next advancement roll.
events.4: You develop a taste for hunting. Gain Animals (Training) 1, Survival 1, Stealth 1 or Athletics (Dexterity) 1.
events.5: You attend a clan council on the homeworld. Gain a Contact there.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You spend time in diplomatic circles. Roll Carouse or Persuade 8+ to gain an Ally; if you fail, gain a Rival instead.
events.9: You are insulted by a noble of a rival clan. You may challenge them to a duel; if you refuse, lose SOC −2. If you challenge, roll Melee (Natural) 9+. If you succeed, gain SOC +1 and DM+2 to your next advancement roll; if you fail, lose SOC −2 and suffer DM-2 to your next advancement roll.
events.10: You are offered membership of a conspiracy in the upper echelons of your clan. If you refuse, gain the conspiracy as an Enemy. If you accept, roll Deception 8+ or Persuade 8+. If you fail, roll on the Mishap table as the conspiracy collapses. If you succeed, gain one of Deception 1, Persuade 1, SOC +1 or TER +1.
events.11: You are trusted by the great lords of your clan. Gain TER +2, or gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll.
events.12: You excel in your role. You are automatically promoted.
